title: Match the socks

steps.text: Dump clean socks onto a table or bed.
steps.tip: Keep them on a towel so they stay clean.

steps.text: Find two that match in color and size.
steps.tip: Hold them next to each other in the light.

steps.text: Fold the pair together and make a stack.
steps.tip: Lonely socks go in a 'missing' pile for a grown-up.

done_when: Matched pairs are in a stack
Unmatched socks are in one small pile
parent_notes: Quiet extra chore. Fine motor practice. Do not scold leftover singles.
